ACT I OF 1989
ACT I OF 1989
SIND CIVIL
SERVANTS (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1988
An Act to amend
the Sind Civil Servants Act, 1973
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part IV, 9th February, 1989]
No.PAS/Legis-B-9/88, dated
9-2-1989.-- The Sind Civil Servants (Amendment) Bill, 1988 having been
passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sind on 21st December, 1988 and assented
to by the Governor of Sind on 23rd January, 1989 is hereby published
as an Act of the Legislature of Sind.
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the Sind Civil Servants
(Amendment) Act, 1988.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 13 of Sind Act XIV of 1973

ACT I OF 1989
ACT I OF 1989
SIND CIVIL
SERVANTS (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1988
An Act to amend
the Sind Civil Servants Act, 1973
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part IV, 9th February, 1989]
No.PAS/Legis-B-9/88, dated
9-2-1989.-- The Sind Civil Servants (Amendment) Bill, 1988 having been
passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sind on 21st December, 1988 and assented
to by the Governor of Sind on 23rd January, 1989 is hereby published
as an Act of the Legislature of Sind.
2. Amendment of section 13 of
Sind Act XIV of 1973: -In the Sind Civil Servants Act, 1973, in section 13,
in clause (i) after semi-colon, the following proviso shall be inserted:--
"Provided that no civil
servant shall be retired unless he has been informed in writing of the grounds
of the action proposed to be taken against him and has been given reasonable
opportunity of showing cause against that action."

Repeal of Sind Ordinance VIII of 1988
